facts.en: Completed a diploma in Project Administration at Fictional Institute D100 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D100 完成项目行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a project documentation clerk at Fictional Delivery Office D100 from 2022-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-02 至 2026-08 在虚构交付办公室 D100 担任项目文件文员。

facts.en: Registered project documents with revision, owner and receipt-date fields using an approved procedure.
facts.zh: 依照获批流程登记项目文件，包含修订版、负责人及收件日期字段。

facts.en: Checked mandatory metadata and duplicate document references before routing records to reviewers.
facts.zh: 将记录转交审核者前检查必填元数据及重复文件编号。

facts.en: With the records lead, reviewed 260 register entries during 2025-07.
facts.zh: 在 2025-07 与记录负责人合作复查 260 条登记记录。

facts.en: The team found 20 entries missing an owner reference, restored 17 from approved handovers and left 3 visibly pending.
facts.zh: 团队发现 20 条记录缺少负责人引用，从获批交接恢复 17 条，并保留 3 条明确待定。

facts.en: Distributed approved revisions to authorized recipient lists and retained superseded versions according to procedure.
facts.zh: 向授权接收者名单分发获批修订版，并依流程保留过期版本。

facts.en: Maintained issue and correction logs with reviewer approval references, without overwriting historical records.
facts.zh: 维护附审核批准引用的问题及更正记录，不覆盖历史记录。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-02 handover checklist that the records lead approved and adopted.
facts.zh: 2026-02 准备交接清单，由记录负责人批准并采纳。

facts.en: Drafted an optional folder-icon scheme in 2026-05; it remained a proposal and was not deployed.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草可选文件夹图标方案；仍为提案，未部署。

facts.en: Responded to internal retrieval requests by locating approved versions and recording request identifiers.
facts.zh: 通过查找获批版本并记录请求标识，处理内部调阅请求。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet validation lists and filters to produce weekly pending-review summaries.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格验证列表及筛选生成每周待审摘要。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 peak, maintained registers for 7 work packages; the normal 2026-08 assignment was 4.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期维护 7 个工作包登记表；2026-08 常规分工为 4 个。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-04 records-formatting refresher with fictional sample documents, separate from employment outputs.
facts.zh: 2024-04 使用虚构示例文件完成记录格式复习课程，与任职产出分开。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Craft Archive V100 on Saturdays from 2023-03 to 2023-08 while employed.
facts.zh: 2023-03 至 2023-08 任职期间，星期六在虚构手工档案社团 V100 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the archive, sorted donated pattern folders by topic without managing corporate project records.
facts.zh: 为该社团按主题整理捐赠图样文件夹，未管理企业项目记录。

facts.en: Built a personal index of fictional lighthouse postcards in 2020, unrelated to client projects.
facts.zh: 2020 年建立个人虚构灯塔明信片索引，与客户项目无关。

facts.en: Keeps a hobby notebook of simple embroidery patterns.
facts.zh: 保留简单刺绣图案爱好笔记。

facts.en: Routed new access requests to the project owner and excluded unnecessary personal details from shared summaries.
facts.zh: 将新访问请求转交项目负责人，并从共享摘要排除不必要的个人详情。

facts.en: No authority for project budget approval, engineering sign-off or legal retention-policy design is claimed; none is required by this vacancy.
facts.zh: 不声称拥有项目预算审批、工程签字或法律保留政策设计权限；本空缺均不要求。
